name: Saudi Public Transport Company
summary: Saudi Public Transport Company (SAPTCO) is a prominent provider of transportation solutions, serving customers both domestically within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company's diverse operations are structured across passenger services, specialized logistics, and public transportation infrastructure projects. For individuals, SAPTCO offers a range of options including school, university, and staff bus transport, private vehicle hire, extensive intercity, international, and urban transit networks, and luxury limousine services catering to both corporate and private clients. Furthermore, it operates Rekab, an innovative on-demand mobility platform. Beyond passenger conveyance, the company manages cargo and parcel delivery, provides VIP logistical support, and facilitates vehicle rentals, contract services, leasing, and charters. SAPTCO also plays a key role in the operation and upkeep of various fleets, encompassing trains, metros, motor vehicles, trucks, and buses, in addition to organizing travel tours. Founded in 1979, the company maintains its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
